About the Role
The Concord Haematology Department delivers world-class tertiary Haematology clinical care, supported by active clinical, translational, and basic research. As one of the largest Haematology Clinical Research Units in NSW, we have recruited over 1000 patients to more than 140 trials since 2005.

Our Clinical Research Unit is led by Dr Nicole Wong Doo (Director) and Jennifer Harman (Manager). Our unit is staffed by a Clinical Coordination Division of five Registered Nurses and five Clinical Research Coordinators, all with tertiary science qualifications. Our highly skilled Business Operations Division efficiently meet our regulatory and reporting obligations, and support the team in various high-level administrative functions, in clinical trials governance and financial management. Ten haematologist investigators are supported by several clinical research fellows.

Our broad portfolio with 28 currently recruiting trials and 32 trials in follow-up is particularly strong in trials in lymphoproliferative diseases. As a national leader in accessing emerging therapies, our unit has a high proportion of patients referred for clinical trial participation both within Sydney and across NSW and ACT.

In this role you will be required to:

Assist with patient assessment for clinical trial eligibility, supporting recruitment activities and providing clear information to patients regarding trial requirements and treatments.

Coordinate and conduct patient study visits, including arranging and performing diagnostic investigations within scope of practice.

Maintain accurate and timely documentation in eMR systems and ensure clinical trial data is up to date across all required databases (Self training on databases is required within the scope of the role).

Coordinate the collection, processing, storage, and transport of pathology specimens in accordance with protocol and regulatory requirements. Adequate training will be provided. 

Liaise with multidisciplinary teams to ensure required clinical data is available for data entry and central review.

Participate in and coordinate monitoring visits with external sponsors, pharmaceutical companies, and research organisations.

Ensure accurate recording and maintenance of clinical trial data to meet Sydney LHD and study-specific contractual obligations.

Undertake primary responsibility for allocated clinical trials as both Lead and Backup Study Coordinator.

Act as the primary liaison and project coordinator for assigned studies, ensuring effective study conduct and stakeholder communication.

Ideal Candidate

Current nursing registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (AHPRA).

Understanding of evidence informed practice and critical thinking.

Effective interpersonal skills, excellent written and verbal communication skills within a multidisciplinary team.

Clinical Research-Clinical Trial experience is desirable.

Ability to work Mon-Fri shifts with the potential for occasional overtime, to meet Blood sampling requirements. Flexible working hours between 0700 - 1730hrs.

The Marketing Specialist will identify market opportunities and develop, coordinate and implement marketing strategies for Totalyty and its clients. The position will provide strategic advice regarding product positioning, pricing, promotional activities, digital marketing, Amazon marketplace visibility and distribution channels.  The successful candidate will analyse market and performance information, prepare marketing plans, coordinate campaigns and provide recommendations to help brands strengthen their presence and commercial performance across Amazon and related e-commerce channels.  This is a strategic and analytical marketing position and is not a predominantly sales, graphic design, customer service or advertising production role.   Benefits      Competitive salary plus superannuation.  Full-time professional marketing position.  Exposure to established Australian and international consumer brands.  Opportunities to work across different products and market categories.  Professional development within the Amazon and e-commerce marketing sector.  Supportive and collaborative working environment.  Opportunities for career growth as the business expands.    Task & responsibilities  Key Duties and Responsibilities  The Marketing Specialist will be responsible for:   Developing and implementing marketing strategies, objectives and programs to support the growth of Totalyty and its client brands.  Conducting market and competitor research to identify customer trends, product opportunities and emerging market segments.  Analysing marketplace, sales, customer and campaign data to develop evidence-based marketing recommendations.  Advising clients on product positioning, pricing, promotional strategies, advertising and e-commerce distribution channels.  Preparing marketing plans for product launches, seasonal campaigns, brand expansion and entry into new Amazon marketplaces.  Planning and coordinating integrated marketing campaigns across Amazon, search, social media, email and other digital channels.  Developing strategies for product listing optimisation, keyword positioning, brand presentation and organic search visibility.  Monitoring campaign performance, conversion rates, traffic and advertising expenditure and recommending improvements to maximise return on investment.  Coordinating with clients, creative professionals, content providers and external agencies to implement approved marketing activities.  Preparing marketing briefs, campaign reports, marketplace reviews and strategic recommendations for management and clients.    Qualification & experience  To be considered for this position, applicants should have:   A Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Marketing, Advertising, Business Communications, Public Relations, Commerce or a closely related discipline.  At least two to three years of relevant professional marketing experience.  Demonstrated experience developing and implementing marketing strategies and plans.  Experience conducting market, customer and competitor research.  Strong knowledge of product positioning, pricing, promotion and digital distribution channels.  Experience analysing marketing, sales and campaign performance data.  Knowledge of Amazon, e-commerce marketplaces or online retail environments is highly desirable.  Experience with digital marketing, SEO, sponsored advertising, content optimisation and associated analytics.  Strong commercial judgement and the ability to translate data into practical marketing recommendations.  Excellent written, verbal, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.  The ability to manage multiple client projects, campaigns and deadlines.  Strong attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative agency environment. We provide end-to-end Amazon marketplace services, including Amazon channel strategy, full-service account management, retail readiness, product listing optimisation, sponsored advertising, promotional planning, Amazon Store development, A+ Content, product imagery and international marketplace expansion.  We work closely with businesses to understand their products, customers and commercial objectives and develop tailored strategies to improve brand visibility, customer engagement, sales conversion and sustainable marketplace growth.
